intent: Compare how Republicans and Democrats rated national economic conditions across the years from 1992 through 2018.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
How did Republicans and Democrats rate national economic conditions across 1992–2018, and how do the two groups compare?

For Dem/Lean Dem, the share rating national economic conditions as excellent or good rises from 6.1628% in 1992 to a peak of 71.1628% in 2000, falls to 11.1628% in 2008, then rises to 43.1628% in 2018.

Republicans (Rep/Lean Rep) rate national economic conditions higher than Democrats (Dem/Lean Dem) in most years shown, with the gap largest around 2000 (78.1628% vs 71.1628%) and reversing in 2018 when Democrats are higher (43.1628% vs 19.1628%).
